description.value: Brooklyn Dumpling Shop is a New York-founded fast casual Asian fusion chain that brings creative, globally-inspired dumplings to Vancouver's busy Robson Street corridor. The menu leans into bold, unexpected combinations — Korean BBQ Ribeye, Bacon Cheeseburger, Pork Soup dumplings — built around the idea that everything is better stuffed in a dumpling. It's a quick, filling stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.
